scope: Read-only audit of pre-I1 interfaces; no inference, mj_step, training, control experiment, collision completion or reward tuning

baseline_tests.origin: Parent task supplied A-H baseline; this auditor did not rerun tests

body_velocity.requires: unchanged k1_walk.pt plus torch plus free base

joint_target_pd.semantics: absolute joint target radians in official robot order; explicit contract recommended
joint_target_pd.requires: MuJoCo named unit-gear motors and task PD arrays; no pt inference
joint_target_pd.note: Software effort limits are task values, not wider XML motor bounds; range rejection/clip policy must be explicit

information_boundary.actor_allowed: Current or past observation under explicit simulation_state or sensor_estimate mode, own proprioception, previous delivered action, validity/age; optional causal forecast clearly tagged estimate
actor_prohibited: initial launch secret or future launch time/target
information_boundary.critic_privileged_allowed: Current exact simulator state, ball orientation/spin and declared physics parameters only in separate channel
information_boundary.offline_labels: Future actual and counterfactual crossings/outcomes/recovery, after episode, never concatenated into actor observation

reset_requirements: mj_resetData; restore task initial robot pose and ball launch input
named qpos/dof/actuator maps; free base world_joint and ball_free separately
zero commands and previous action; clear last_action/history/filter/targets/counts/warning baseline
new GoalDetector and contact episodes; clear prediction/coverage/controller state and traces
owned local seeded RNG; frozen seed and full initial state/config metadata; failure does not silently retry

episode_requirements.defended_goal: right by existing scenario, explicit configuration required
episode_requirements.goal_test: GoalDetector whole-ball event; contact alone is neither goal nor save
episode_requirements.end_semantics: Goal/miss can latch but recovery observation may need continued physics; choose explicit recovery tail
episode_requirements.terminated_vs_truncated: physical/task terminal reasons distinct from max-duration truncation; numerical errors require evidence and explicit policy
episode_requirements.reward: I1 placeholder or minimal documented semantics only; no tuning or training readiness claim

recorder_requirements: pre-state/action/target/raw PD and delivered control match each physics interval
post-state/applied torque/contact force/warnings/exit event must be sampled after delivered physics step
full robot and ball state; per-step counts and causal actor timestamp
separate current actor/critic data from finalized offline labels
immutable source/config/model/seed identifiers; reset trace cannot retain prior episode

i2_gaps.gap: Unified free-base standing, movement, intercept and recovery dynamic task
i2_gaps.evidence: Current SceneSimulation exposes zero_torque and k1_walk only; H prototype couples frozen walking policy and tested arm pulse
F/G reads exact current sim ball position and velocities including spin; no camera/detector/noise/latency sensor pipeline
Official shoulder_pitch, hip_pitch and ankle_pitch are visual-only; ball inertia comment says to be calibrated; G excludes goal/robot contacts
i2_gaps.status: record limitations; do not complete collision in I1

i2_gaps.gap: Training algorithm, reward, curriculum and vector throughput
i2_gaps.evidence: Existing core is serial validation and inference; no established optimizer or RL rollout contract
i2_gaps.status: I2 design and validation needed; no train launch

i2_gaps.evidence: run_shot stops at first exit while E continues recovery; contacts are not save outcome
i2_gaps.status: explicit episode policy and meaningful trajectory checks required

i1_action_backend_implementation.later_validation: scripts/validate_training_env.py has separate protocol/results; dynamic runs are outside this static audit scope
